claims.quote: Etymology: –ensis, suffix denoting place: Somjin River, South Korea, the type locality.

regions.name: Somjin
regions.quote: L. somjinensis is restricted to rivers flowing to the west coast and Geogeum Island, the Somjin, Dongin and Tamjin rivers (Kim S-h, et al. 2023).
